description: Land cover at a point in mainland France: the CORINE Land Cover 2018 class (code and label, e.g. 112 "Discontinuous urban fabric") of the polygon containing the point, with its area. Resolution is 25 ha mapping units, so it describes the surrounding area, not the exact spot. found:false when the point is outside the coverage (sea, abroad, overseas).
name: fr_land_cover
